general.question: What is an FAQ section?
general.answer: An FAQ section can be used to quickly answer common questions about your business like "Where do you ship to?", "What are your opening hours?", or "How can I book a service?".

general.question: Why do FAQs matter?
general.answer: FAQs help your customers find answers fast and reduce the number of support requests you receive.

general.question: Where can I add my FAQs?
general.answer: You can place your FAQs on any page, such as your homepage, product pages, or a dedicated support page.

setup.question: How do I add a new FAQ?
setup.answer: You can add a new FAQ by clicking the "Add FAQ" button in the FAQ manager and filling in the question and answer fields.

setup.question: Can I edit existing FAQs?
setup.answer: Yes, you can edit any existing FAQ by clicking the edit icon next to it in the FAQ manager.

setup.question: How do I organize my FAQs?
setup.answer: You can organize your FAQs by dragging and dropping them into your preferred order in the FAQ manager.
